question_en: Summarize the number of agreements per TS (which spec sees the most consensus).
original_query: MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291'] RETURN sp.specNumber, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCount ORDER BY agrCount DESC
reference_query:
MATCH (sp:Spec)
WHERE sp.specNumber IN ['38.201','38.202','38.211','38.212','38.213','38.214','38.215','38.291']
WITH DISTINCT sp.specNumber AS specNumber
OPTIONAL MATCH (agr:Agreement)-[:REFERENCES]->(cr:CR)-[:MODIFIES]->(target:Spec)
WHERE target.specNumber = specNumber
RETURN specNumber, count(DISTINCT agr) AS agrCount
ORDER BY agrCount DESC, specNumber ASC
